findings.title: Ownership check requireOwner removed between base and head; deleteAccount is no longer guarded by it
findings.description: The cited lines exist only at base: head's src/auth.js keeps requireUser (authentication) but drops requireOwner (authorisation), and nothing at head replaces the userId-equals-params.id comparison before accounts.remove. The citation is side: base because the evidence is the code that was removed; check --drift skips base citations by design (deleted code has no current counterpart).
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can delete any account by id.
findings.prerequisites: The route wiring for deleteAccount no longer applies an ownership middleware (verify in the router, outside this packet).
findings.remediation: Restore an ownership check before accounts.remove, or apply it at the route.
